title: Uttam Sugar Mills (UTTAMSUGAR) - LIVE deep dive #8, first IT/FMCG/Consumer-Durables-frame draw (protocol v1.4, stages 2-7): method test, no verdict; card v1.5 size 0; 7 live deep-dive calls + 3 card calls
body: LIVE method test (L9, L21): random draw (Random(20261205)) from 149 IT (38) / FMCG (53) / Consumer Durables (58) names in the India Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band at the 23-Nov-2026 close (DATE1 of the 24-Nov bhavcopy), classified by industry_map.csv (0 unmapped; prereg sha256 511f2565... written 04:57 UTC before the frame). SKIPS: none - walk #1 (3rd live draw in a row on #1). The map files this sugar miller under FMCG / Agricultural Food. S2 passed: B.K. Kapur unmodified FY26 with an Emphasis of Matter (State of Uttarakhand loan interest unprovided since 2008, waiver pending); ratings upgraded CARE A Stable (Sep-2025) and India Ratings A Stable (Jun-2026); pledge 0; solvency not red (S3 seasonal ST debt); PEAD Q3 (SUE +0.28, 31-Oct-2026). FINDINGS: (1) a government-administered spread: at 9.42% recovery the SAP (Rs 390-405/qtl) costs ~Rs 4,150 per qtl of sugar vs Rs 4,143 realisation; profit comes from by-products and recovery; every Rs 10/qtl SAP = Rs 30-39 cr EBITDA (15-19% of TTM); per-tonne rebuild reproduces FY26 EBITDA within 2%; (2) L40: the ESY 2026-27 OMC tender (16-Oct-2026) excludes juice/syrup/B-heavy ethanol while the 300 KLPD distillery rating is B-heavy/syrup-based - absent from the 31-Oct-2026 results deck; UP SAP 2026-27 not yet announced (UP = 74% of capacity, L41); (3) L44 core EPS = reported (other income 5% of PBT) - the binding read is temperature: 15.2x core/normalised EPS = 90th percentile of own FY-end P/Es (median 8.0x) after an 86% rise off the 2026 low; (4) L42 group ROIC ~8.9% on seasonal-average capital (7.3% March; 12.7% September), full-cycle ROIIC 5.6% < CoE 12.5%; UDL capex payback 2.8 vs 5.2 yrs two ways; (5) votes: MD re-appointment 5.3% against net of promoters (2.2% non-promoter turnout; 'promoter interested: No' on his own item); ~5.43 m promoter shares (19% of the block) never vote; MD pay Rs 9.2 cr = 9.3% of PAT; preference redemption extended to 2029 in Feb-2026 then fully redeemed by Jul-2026; CFO resigned Sep-2026. VALUATION: worksheet base IRR 7.5%; DCF below net debt in bear (L21); EV 5-yr multiple 0.74x raw / 0.89x anchored vs 1.76x hurdle -> size 0 (8 of 8 live cards). Card P(>=3x) 0.8% vs base 21% - flagged before scoring as probably too low for a commodity cyclical (stock 12.7x in 2020-23). LESSON CANDIDATES: L40 as a dated table of recurring administered prices; graded partial-input-withdrawal field; seasonal-average capital; HOT-vs-own-history can bind when L44 does not; right-tail calibration for cyclicals; FMCG frame contains commodity processors.

title: Uttam Sugar variant view (Nov-2026): no claimable mispricing; a cyclical priced at the 90th percentile of its own P/E history, with an undisclosed adverse ethanol-tender change
body: At Rs 348.50 the stock is 15.2x core/normalised EPS vs an own 10-yr median of 8.0x, after an 86% rise on the Jul-Aug 2026 sugar-price spike while H1 FY27 PBT fell 62%. Group ROIC ~9% and ROIIC 5.6% < CoE, so value above net debt is an exit-multiple bet. The ESY 2026-27 tender excludes B-heavy/syrup ethanol (not in the Q2 deck) and the 2026-27 UP SAP is pending. For the other side: A-rated, September net debt ~Rs 30 cr, tight national sugar stocks, possible MSP hike. No buy/sell verdict (method test).

title: For administered-price businesses, L40 is a dated table of recurring government decisions, and the newest one may be missing from company filings
body: Uttam Sugar (live dd #8): cane SAP (state), sugar MSP and export/quota orders (GoI), ethanol tender design (GoI/OMCs) set most of the P&L every year. The ESY 2026-27 tender (16-Oct-2026) excluded B-heavy/syrup ethanol - the feedstock the company's 300 KLPD rating is based on - and the 31-Oct-2026 results deck did not mention it. Rule candidate: list each administered price with its last value, next decision date and whether the latest decision appears in the company's own filings; treat a missing one as a disclosure flag (L40). The card's binary core-asset trigger cannot express a partial input withdrawal.

title: The decision card's right tail is uncalibrated for commodity cyclicals (P(>=3x) 0.8% for a stock that went 12.7x in 2020-23)
body: Card v1.5 anchors only P(<=0.5x) and P(blow-up) to the class base rate (L43). With three scenarios and lognormal sigma 0.40, Uttam Sugar's P(>=3x) came out 0.8% vs the class 21% while its own price went 41 -> 522 in 2020-23 and 18 -> 208 in 2016-17. Written before scoring. Candidate pre-registered test: anchor P(>=3x) too (or widen sigma for cyclicals) and score both on live calls. Also: seasonal balance sheets need average capital (ROIC 7.3% March vs 12.7% September).

title: Uttam Sugar Mills Ltd (NSE UTTAMSUGAR, BSE 532729)
body: Integrated sugar miller: 27,000 TCD at Barkatpur (8,500), Shermau (6,000), Khaikheri (5,500) in western UP and Libberheri (7,000) in Uttarakhand; 300 KLPD molasses distilleries (250 Barkatpur, 50 Libberheri; B-heavy/syrup rating), 122 MW co-generation, 83.73% of Uttam Distilleries Ltd (40 KLPD grain, expanding to 160 KLPD by Mar-2027). title: Decision card UTTAMSUGAR 2026-11-25 (paper)
body: Decision card v1 for Uttam Sugar Mills Ltd (integrated sugar, distillery, co-generation; western UP + Uttarakhand). Rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 0.89x anchored (raw 0.74x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Thesis: Method-test thesis: Uttam Sugar Mills crushes cane at four mills (27,000 TCD: Barkatpur 8,500, Shermau 6,000, Khaikheri 5,500 in western UP; Libberheri 7,000 in Uttarakhand), sells sugar (FY26 36.8 lakh qtl at Rs 4,143/qtl, incl. a branded/specialty line), ethanol/ENA (847 lakh BL from 300 KLPD of molasses distilleries + a 40 KLPD grain distillery at 83.7%-owned UDL) and surplus power (1,006 lakh kWh to UPPCL/UPCL). Every major price is administered: cane cost is the state-set SAP (Rs 390-405/qtl for SS 2025-26, ~74% of capacity in UP), sugar has a Rs 31/kg MSP frozen since 2019 plus monthly release quotas and an export ban (13-May-2026), and ethanol is sold to OMCs at government-fixed feedstock prices. At a 9.42% recovery the SAP alone costs ~Rs 4,150 per qtl of sugar - about the sugar price - so profit comes from by-products and recovery. Group ROIC ~9% on seasonal-average capital (full-cycle ROIIC ~5.6%) is below a 12.5% cost of equity; EPS FY17 27.95 -> FY26 26.30. Variant view: Market: at Rs 348.50 (mcap Rs 1,329 cr) the stock trades at 14.7x reported TTM EPS (23.72) and 15.2x core / 10-year-average EPS (22.9-23.0) - HOT vs its own 10-year FY-end median (8.0x; 90th percentile) and NORMAL vs UP-sugar peers (Balrampur 31x, Triveni 15.5x, Dhampur 11.4x). The price rose from ~Rs 187 (2026 low) to 389 in 2026 on a domestic sugar-price spike (Rs 48 -> 56/kg Jul-Aug 2026, stock limits imposed) despite H1 FY27 PBT -62% after a flood-hit crush (-25%). Our read: no mispricing we can claim; the price already capitalises a good 2026-27 season. (1) Core EPS ~= reported (other income 5% of PBT, exceptionals -1.35 cr) - L44 check passes, unlike SHK. (2) Group ROIC ~9% and ROIIC ~5.6% < CoE, so the DCF is near zero and every scenario above 1x is an exit-multiple bet (L21); our base exit 9x (FY22-26 median) implies de-rating from 15x. (3) A material government-input change is missing from the company's own disclosures (L40): the ESY 2026-27 OMC tender (BPCL, 16-Oct-2026) seeks no ethanol from cane juice, syrup or B-heavy molasses, while three UP units ran on B-heavy and Barkatpur on syrup in SS 2025-26 and the 300 KLPD rating is 'based on B-heavy/syrup'; the 31-Oct-2026 results deck does not mention it. (4) The 2026-27 UP SAP is not yet announced (farmers ask Rs 500 vs 390-400). Evidence for the other side: ratings upgraded twice (CARE A Stable Sep-2025; India Ratings A Stable Jun-2026), debt falls to ~Rs 30 cr net each September, recovery improving (9.42% vs 8.94%), C-heavy ethanol stays eligible and lost B-heavy diversion returns as extra sugar into a tight market (closing stock ~4.25 mt), and an MSP hike (ISMA asks Rs 40-41/kg) would lift every miller. Departure from the outside view: raw P(blow-up) 10% < class 15% (A-rated, no pledge) and raw P(<=0.5x) far above 11% because the price sits at 1.9x the own-history P/E median; default w=0.5. Checked by paper calls thesis:paper-call:UTTAMSUGAR:*. Open soft flags: 4. P(≥3x) 1% vs base 21%; P(≤0.5x) 38% vs base 11.3%; EV 5-yr multiple 0.74x vs hurdle 1.76x. Review 2027-02-15.

override_log.why: L40 checked: the B-heavy/syrup ethanol exclusion is a withdrawn government input, but it does not remove a licence or lease the business depends on - C-heavy molasses ethanol stays eligible, diverted sucrose returns as saleable sugar, and the distillery is 25% of segment EBIT. The SAP is an annual administered price, not a concession. Weighed in the bear case and the blow-up note instead.
